in_hindi.name: सूनायना
in_hindi.meaning: आगे वापस आने वाली शब्द (word for 'good news')

in_marathi.name: Sunaina
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sunaina हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sunaina is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Su-Nidhana', which means 'listening' or 'hearing'. In Hindu mythology, this name is often associated with the goddess Saraswati, who is the embodiment of knowledge, learning, and music. Sunaina is believed to bestow the qualities of wisdom, intelligence, and a deep love for the arts upon those who bear this name.
